properties.note: Together with chg:a-moved-record-that-sat-still-is-parsed-once-per-design this retires the finding's headline: the fixed ~1.1 s is now ~0.4 s on a 16 MB moved record and ~50 ms on a small one (measured the same day, same copy, same method: 388/410/394 and 50/57/51 ms). The MECHANISM the finding describes — first store read after any write, once per generation, not the text index — was correct and located the cause; its numbers are what moved. The finding's own `value` carries the after figures beside the before.
